tool_evidence.title: Detect opening/pauses, cut video, and write JSON report: $ python - <<'PY' import json, re, subprocess, math, os from pathlib import Path  INPUT='data/input_video.mp4' OUT_VIDEO='compressed_video.mp4' OUT_JSON='compression_report.json'  # Tunables FREEZE_N='0.003' FREEZE_D='2' FREEZE_SCAN_SECONDS='90' OPENING_KEEP_TAIL=0.20 SILENCE_NOISE_DB='-22dB' SILENCE_MIN_D='2.0' MERGE_GAP=0.20 PAD=0.15 MIN_AFTER_PAD=0.50   def run(cmd):     subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)  def duration_seconds(path):     p=subprocess.run(         ['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_entries','format=duration','-of','default=nk=1:nw=1',path],         check=True, capture_output=True, text=True     )     return float(p.stdout.strip())  def has_audio(path):     p=subprocess.run(         ['ffprobe','-v','error','-select_streams','a:0','-show_entries','stream=codec_type','-of','csv=p=0',path],         check=False, capture_output=True, text=True     )     return p.returncode==0 and p.stdout.strip()!=''  orig_dur=duration_seconds(INPUT)  # 1) Detect frozen opening (video static) freeze_log='__freezedetect.log' run([     'ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-y','-t',FREEZE_SCAN_SECONDS,'-i',INPUT,     '-vf',f'freezedetect=n={FREEZE_N}:d={FREEZE_D}',     '-map','0:v:0','-f','null','-' ]) # ffmpeg writes freezedetect to stderr; capture by rerunning with stderr redirected with open(freeze_log,'w') as f:     subprocess.run([         'ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-y','-t',FREEZE_SCAN_SECONDS,'-i',INPUT,         '-vf',f'freezedetect=n={FREEZE_N}:d={FREEZE_D}',         '-map','0:v:0','-f','null','-'     ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=f, check=True)  freeze_events=[] for line in open(freeze_log,'r',errors='ignore'):     m=re.search(r'freeze_start: ([0-9.]+)', line)     if m:         freeze_events.append(('start', float(m.group(1))))     m=re.search(r'freeze_end: ([0-9.]+)', line)     if m:         freeze_events.append(('end', float(m.group(1))))  opening_end=0.0 # heuristic: if we see freeze events starting very early, take the last freeze_end within scan window has_early_freeze=any(t=='start' and v<=5.0 for t,v in freeze_events) if has_early_freeze:     opening_end=max((v for t,v in freeze_events if t=='end'), default=0.0) opening_cut_end=max(0.0, opening_end-OPENING_KEEP_TAIL)  # 2) Detect long pauses via audio silencedetect silence_log='__silencedetect.log' with open(silence_log,'w') as f:     subprocess.run([         'ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-y','-i',INPUT,         '-vn','-af',f'silencedetect=noise={SILENCE_NOISE_DB}:d={SILENCE_MIN_D}',         '-f','null','-'     ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=f, check=True)  silences=[] cur=None for line in open(silence_log,'r',errors='ignore'):     m=re.search(r'silence_start: ([0-9.]+)', line)     if m:         cur=float(m.group(1))         continue     m=re.search(r'silence_end: ([0-9.]+) \| silence_duration: ([0-9.]+)', line)     if m and cur is not None:         silences.append([cur, float(m.group(1))])         cur=None  silences.sort() # merge nearby silences merged=[] for s,e in silences:     if not merged:         merged.append([s,e])         continue     ps,pe=merged[-1]     if s<=pe+MERGE_GAP:         merged[-1][1]=max(pe,e)     else:         merged.append([s,e])  # 3) Build final removal segments (opening + silences), with padding removed=[] if opening_cut_end>=2.0:     removed.append([0.0, opening_cut_end])  for s,e in merged:     if e<=opening_cut_end:         continue     s=max(s, opening_cut_end)     s2=s+PAD     e2=e-PAD     if e2-s2>=MIN_AFTER_PAD:         removed.append([s2,e2])  removed.sort() final=[] for s,e in removed:     if not final:         final.append([s,e])         continue     ps,pe=final[-1]     if s<=pe+MERGE_GAP:         final[-1][1]=max(pe,e)     else:         final.append([s,e])  # clamp final2=[] for s,e in final:     s=max(0.0, min(s, orig_dur))     e=max(0.0, min(e, orig_dur))     if e-s>=MIN_AFTER_PAD:         final2.append([s,e]) final=final2  # 4) Complement -> kept segments kept=[] prev=0.0 for s,e in final:     if s-prev>0.02:         kept.append([prev,s])     prev=e if orig_dur-prev>0.02:     kept.append([prev, orig_dur])  if not kept:     raise SystemExit('No kept segments computed; refusing to output empty video.')  audio_ok=has_audio(INPUT)  # 5) ffmpeg trim+concat (re-encode once) filter_parts=[] concat_inputs=[] for i,(s,e) in enumerate(kept):     filter_parts.append(f"[0:v]trim=start={s:.3f}:end={e:.3f},setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[v{i}]")     concat_inputs.append(f"[v{i}]")     if audio_ok:         filter_parts.append(f"[0:a]atrim=start={s:.3f}:end={e:.3f},asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[a{i}]")         concat_inputs.append(f"[a{i}]")  if audio_ok:     concat = ''.join(concat_inputs) + f"concat=n={len(kept)}:v=1:a=1[vout][aout]" else:     concat = ''.join(concat_inputs) + f"concat=n={len(kept)}:v=1:a=0[vout]"  filter_complex=';'.join(filter_parts+[concat])  cmd=['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-y','-i',INPUT,'-filter_complex',filter_complex] if audio_ok:     cmd += ['-map','[vout]','-map','[aout]','-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','23','-c:a','aac','-b:a','128k','-movflags','+faststart',OUT_VIDEO] else:     cmd += ['-map','[vout]','-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','23','-movflags','+faststart',OUT_VIDEO]  run(cmd)  comp_dur=duration_seconds(OUT_VIDEO) removed_dur=max(0.0, orig_dur-comp_dur)  report={     'original_duration_seconds': round(orig_dur, 3),     'compressed_duration_seconds': round(comp_dur, 3),     'removed_duration_seconds': round(removed_dur, 3),     'compression_percentage': round((removed_dur/orig_dur*100.0) if orig_dur>0 else 0.0, 2),     'segments_removed': [         {             'start': round(s, 3),             'end': round(e, 3),             'duration': round(e-s, 3)         } for s,e in final     ] }  Path(OUT_JSON).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))  # cleanup intermediates for p in [freeze_log, silence_log]:     try:         os.remove(p)     except OSError:         pass  print('Wrote', OUT_VIDEO, 'and', OUT_JSON) print('Removed segments:', len(final)) print('Original/Compressed/Removed:', report['original_duration_seconds'], report['compressed_duration_seconds'], report['removed_duration_seconds']) PY

Validate output files exist and preview JSON report: $ ls -lah compressed_video.mp4 compression_report.json && python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('compression_report.json')); print(d.keys()); print('segments', len(d['segments_removed'])); print('math', d['original_duration_seconds']-d['compressed_duration_seconds']-d['removed_duration_seconds']);" && head -n 50 compression_report.json
Remove intermediate audio and log files from workspace: $ rm -f input_audio.wav silencedetect*.log freezedetect.log __freezedetect.log __silencedetect.log && ls -lah | head

Confirm required output files are present with sizes: $ ls -lah compressed_video.mp4 compression_report.json && ffprobe -hide_banner -loglevel error -show_entries format=duration -of default=nk=1:nw=1 compressed_video.mp4

def test_audio_matches_json_segments():
        """Verify compressed video matches what JSON segments describe should be removed.
    
        This test reconstructs audio by removing segments specified in the JSON from
        the original video, then compares it with the actual compressed video audio.
        High correlation means the JSON accurately describes what was cut.
        """
        report = load_report()
        segments = sorted(report["segments_removed"], key=lambda x: x["start"])
        original_video = "/root/data/input_video.mp4"
        original_duration = report["original_duration_seconds"]
    
        # Build the "keep" segments (inverse of removed segments)
        keep_segments = []
        current = 0
        for seg in segments:
            if seg["start"] > current:
                keep_segments.append((current, seg["start"]))
            current = seg["end"]
        if current < original_duration:
            keep_segments.append((current, original_duration))
    
        assert len(keep_segments) > 0, "No segments to keep after removing all specified segments"
    
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            # Create ffmpeg filter to reconstruct audio based on JSON segments
            filter_parts = []
            for i, (start, end) in enumerate(keep_segments):
                filter_parts.append(f"[0:a]atrim=start={start}:end={end},asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[a{i}]")
    
            concat_inputs = "".join(f"[a{i}]" for i in range(len(keep_segments)))
            filter_complex = ";".join(filter_parts) + f";{concat_inputs}concat=n={len(keep_segments)}:v=0:a=1[outa]"
    
            # Reconstruct audio based on JSON segments
            result = subprocess.run([
                "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", original_video,
                "-filter_complex", filter_complex,
                "-map", "[outa]",
                "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1",
                f"{tmpdir}/reconstructed.wav"
            ], capture_output=True)
            assert result.returncode == 0, f"Failed to reconstruct audio: {result.stderr.decode()}"
    
            # Extract audio from actual compressed video
            result = subprocess.run([
                "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", VIDEO_PATH,
                "-vn", "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1",
                f"{tmpdir}/compressed.wav"
            ], capture_output=True)
            assert result.returncode == 0, f"Failed to extract compressed audio: {result.stderr.decode()}"
    
            # Load and compare audio waveforms
            _, reconstructed = wavfile.read(f"{tmpdir}/reconstructed.wav")
            _, compressed = wavfile.read(f"{tmpdir}/compressed.wav")
    
            # Normalize to float
            reconstructed = reconstructed.astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
            compressed = compressed.astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    
            # Truncate to same length (may differ by a few samples due to encoding)
            min_len = min(len(reconstructed), len(compressed))
            reconstructed = reconstructed[:min_len]
            compressed = compressed[:min_len]
    
            # Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient
            correlation = np.corrcoef(reconstructed, compressed)[0, 1]
